_about: The lint for forward-facing lines, from Orb's marks on the first ten (docs/ep/vision.md, 'Orb marks the first ten lines', 2026-10-15). Each rule is traced in docs/narrative/writing-quality.md section 0. Narrative's additions to the banned list are marked proposed: Orb may veto them.

R1_length.why: Orb's directive: Mid-Punch Brevity; marks 3 and 10

R3_banned_words.why: Orb's directive: Ban LLM Thesaurus Words

R4_physical_trigger.why: Orb's directive: physical, blue-collar words; a line reacts to what just happened

R5_no_dynamic_explained.why: Orb's directive: write for the English dub

R6_second_person.why: all ten of Orb's rewrites address the opponent

R9_reference_lines.why: Orb: a style target, trimmed down and punchier

tells: a word or phrase said three times for feeling
a one-word zinger as the last sentence
the same joke device on every line of one fighter
a line that describes the blow or the mechanic
the opponent explained to the opponent (the dynamic said aloud)

stance: wants the rival at full strength
concerned when a launch heads at a crowd
